This '''Krath military officer''' served as [[Aleema Keto]]'s attaché during the [[Krath/Legends|Krath's]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|invasion of Coruscant]] in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. He was the the officer who relayed Keto's orders to [[Mandalore the Indomitable]] to withdraw his troops from that battle.
